### Fixed

- (agent-platform) [Cancel a credential replacement refused for changed consumers](https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/pull/3582) by [@fiunchinho](https://github.com/fiunchinho) — On the credential form, a replacement that can't be saved because the objects using the credential changed is cancelled instead of staying open until it expires; if cancelling fails, the form offers `Cancel request`.

**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/giantswarm/backstage/compare/v3.41.0...v3.41.1
